title: Flow to expect in the Niger at Bamako
shows: Prediction in an ungauged basin: donors by similarity, transferred signatures, the GloFAS check.

site.name: Niger at Bamako, Mali (no gauge in reach)

problem: No gauge I can reach on the Niger at Bamako: what mean flow and Q95 should a water-supply offtake expect?
headline: estimate the mean flow and low-flow (Q95) that a proposed water-supply offtake on the Niger at Bamako should plan around, given no usable gauge record at the site: mean daily flow 0.779 mm/d (screening).

figures.name: s1_site_map.png
figures.caption: The site, in longitude and latitude (no basemap); no catalogue station was listed with it.

figures.name: s2_donors_map.png
figures.caption: The site and the 10 donor gauges the similarity search selected, in longitude and latitude (no basemap); labels are the station ids.

figures.name: s3_signatures_band.png
figures.caption: Flow signatures transferred to the site from 10 donor catchments, with the one-standard-deviation band across donors as error bars and the leave-one-out skill (NSE) where published.

figures.name: s4_monthly_climate.png
figures.caption: Mean monthly precipitation (bars) and FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (line) for the ERA5 cell at the site at 12.60 N, 8.00 W, 30 years ending 2026-09-07.

figures.name: s4_glofas_series.png
figures.caption: Annual maxima of the modelled discharge from GloFAS v4 (Open-Meteo) for the grid cell at the site at 12.60 N, 8.00 W, 1997 to 2026: a model output, indicative only, not a gauge reading.
